content.title: Purdue Basketball: How to Watch #2 Purdue (30-8) vs. #1 Arizona (35-2) & Fan Discussion
content.text: This is it. The final step before Indianapolis. The final step before a return to the Final Four. Forty minutes of basketball separates Purdue basketball and a de facto home game in the Final Four. The team can’t look ahead to that though as they’ve got an incredible challenge in front of them against #1 seed Arizona. Thus far only one #1 seed has gone down. Purdue is looking to make it two. Over the last day and a half on the site we’ve had a look at the odds, a look at the offenses, a statistical overview of Arizona, an interview with the Arizona blogger, a podcast focused on the Texas win and looking at Arizona, and our staff predictions. If you don’t know enough about this matchup it’s on you at this point. Tonight is a late tipoff so make sure to stay caffeinated or grab your adult beverage of choice if you’re of age and prepare for a tough matchup against the Wildcats.Who: #2 Purdue vs. #1 ArizonaWhen: Saturday, March 28, 2026 - 8:49 p.m. ETWhere: San Jose, CA - SAP Center - Capacity - 17,562TV: TBS/truTVPurdue Radio: Purdue Global Radio Network (Rob Blackman, Bobby Riddell)So come and join your fellow Boilermaker fans in our fan discussion (formerly known as the open thread) as we talk about Purdue versus the Arizona Wildcats in the Elite Eight. The winner of this game advances to the Final Four in Indianpolis. It’s win or go home time so there’s only one thing to do. Let’s win!1k Comments
